name: 9/21 EMA Crossover Scalp
entry_long: Go long when the 9-period EMA crosses above the 21-period EMA on a 5-minute candle close, price is trading above both EMAs, and the EMAs are visibly separating (steep angle) after the cross rather than flat/overlapping.
entry_short: Go short when the 9-period EMA crosses below the 21-period EMA on a 5-minute candle close with price below both EMAs and the EMAs separating.
exit: Exit at target or stop; alternatively exit when the 9 EMA begins flattening against the trade direction, or trail the stop using the 9 EMA.
stop: Stop just beyond the low (for longs) or high (for shorts) of the crossover candle, or beyond the most recent swing low/high.
target: Fixed reward:risk of 2:1 from entry versus the initial stop distance.
filters: Avoid sideways/range-bound markets; the strategy performs best when a higher-timeframe trend filter (e.g. 15-minute trend direction) agrees with the crossover direction.
